children: China steel and real estate group's H1 revenue fell 8% yr/yr on weaker steel and property sales
Net income attributable to owners rose 19% yr/yr, despite lower adjusted profit for the period
Company did not declare an interim dividend for the period
STEEL SALES DROP - Co said lower sales volume and weaker pricing in self-manufactured steel products contributed to revenue decline
REAL ESTATE WEAKNESS - Co reported lower real estate revenue and segment losses, citing impairment provisions on properties under development and held for sale
IMPAIRMENT PROVISIONS - Co booked impairment provisions on real estate assets and loan receivables related to lower-tier cities, impacting adjusted profit
